title: D5 3日版 Runner Protection 探索
primary_question: D5 3日 MFE/MAE 半卖是否可以通过保护高质量 runner，减少误伤强趋势票？
primary_variable: read-only protection predicates over D5 runtime AB events
fixed_assumptions: uses D5 3D runtime AB outputs only
same-window B0 vs D5 symbol PnL delta is used as exploratory label
entry BUY meta is joined by symbol and entry_date
key_findings: Entry final_score/residual_score cannot cleanly separate D5误伤票和有效减损票；两组买入时分数都很高。
If protecting final_score>=0.90, it protects 95 D5 events across three windows, nearly disables D5; this is not a precise runner-protection rule.
D5 signal date candidate-list protection has zero coverage: D5-triggered symbols were not in score_diagnostics candidate list on D5 signal date.
Mild-MAE protection is more robust: protecting MAE>-8% has positive first-order effect in all three windows, but still does not rescue full-cycle D5 into a promotable rule.

protection_rule_scores.interpretation: Too broad; mostly disables D5 because most D5 events entered with high score.
More selective, but still score-only and leaves full-cycle D5 event-symbol delta negative.
Most robust simple protection; protects shallower early drawdown as possible runner volatility.
No coverage; D5-triggered holdings were not candidate-list symbols on the D5 signal date.

decision.reason: Runner protection should not be based on entry score alone. A safer next design is D5 3D watch-state: do not sell mild MAE cases immediately; require deeper MAE or 5/10D non-recovery before half sell.

next_actions: Design D5 runner-protection AB as a runtime watch-state, not a simple entry-score exemption.
Candidate rule: at day3, if MAE is between -5% and -8%, mark watch and do not sell; sell only if day5/day10 still has MFE不足 and MAE未修复.
Keep industry/theme out of this version.
